_comment: THE REPAIRS. `windows` is the modern shape: scheduled, self-closing, edited from the Desk. `nodes` is the legacy flat list — still honoured, still what the ops tooling maintenance_prep flow writes — and means 'under repair until removed'. Both may coexist; neither writer clobbers the other. Copy to /data/maintenance.json or point ATLAS_MAINTENANCE at it.

windows.note: alarms stay quiet for these places while the window is open
